title: Stated share total does not reconcile with identified holdings
description: The cap table states 4,250,000 shares issued and outstanding, but identified holdings account for only 3,900,000 (1,800,000 + 1,200,000 + 900,000). 350,000 shares fall short of the identified holdings. Either a holder is undisclosed or the stated total is wrong; in either case the buyer cannot rely on the stated ownership percentages. Unexercised options are excluded from this reconciliation, as they are not issued shares.

title: Missing: Shareholders Agreement
description: No document satisfying this request was found in the data room. Governs transfer restrictions, drag-along and tag-along rights, any of which can block or complicate a sale.
challenge_reason: A closely held or early-stage company may not have a standalone Shareholders Agreement if governance and transfer restrictions are fully detailed within the corporate bylaws or articles of incorporation.

title: Missing: Equity incentive plan document
description: No document satisfying this request was found in the data room. This document is required because the corpus states: "410,000 options have been granted to employees". Options granted without an adopted plan may be invalid, leaving the company exposed to claims from holders and the cap table materially misstated.
challenge_reason: The 410,000 options could have been granted as individual standalone non-statutory stock options approved directly by the board of directors, which does not strictly require a formal equity incentive plan document.

title: Missing: Accounts receivable ageing schedule
description: No document satisfying this request was found in the data room. Reveals collection risk that headline revenue figures conceal.
challenge_reason: An accounts receivable aging schedule may be immaterial or irrelevant if the target operates on a subscription or cash-collection basis with negligible outstanding receivables.

title: Missing: Litigation schedule or no-litigation confirmation
description: No document satisfying this request was found in the data room. Undisclosed litigation is a common source of post-closing dispute.
challenge_reason: The objection is correct. The absence of a litigation schedule in a data room is standard for companies without active disputes. No-litigation representations are handled in the transaction documents, making this finding conceptually incorrect.

title: Missing: Debt agreements and loan documentation
description: No document satisfying this request was found in the data room. Debt frequently carries change-of-control acceleration clauses.
challenge_reason: A missing document finding is only valid if there is evidence that the target has outstanding debt (e.g., from financial statements or balance sheet lines). Without any evidence of existing debt liabilities, flagging this as a gap is purely speculative.

title: Missing: Tax returns for the last three years
description: No document satisfying this request was found in the data room. Unpaid or disputed tax transfers to the buyer.
challenge_reason: Historical tax liabilities can be managed through standard pre-closing tax representations and indemnities in the acquisition agreement, reducing the need for physical historical returns.
